mapper.insert: insert into profile values( #{mem_id}, null, null, null, 0, 0, null, #{mem_bir} )
mapper.select: SELECT P.MEM_ID, M.MEM_NICKNAME, M.MEM_ID, M.MEM_BIR, P.PROFILE_PHOTO, P.PROFILE_HEADERPHOTO, P.PROFILE_INTRO, P.PROFILE_URL, (SELECT count(*) FROM POST WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId}) AS profile_postcnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT FRIEND_FROMID AS TOID, FRIEND_STATUS FROM FRIEND WHERE FRIEND_TOID = #{memId} UNION ALL SELECT FRIEND_TOID AS TOID, FRIEND_STATUS FROM FRIEND WHERE FRIEND_FROMID = #{memId}) B WHERE B.FRIEND_STATUS = 1) AS profile_friendcnt FROM PROFILE P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEM_ID = M.MEM_ID WHERE P.MEM_ID = #{memId}
SELECT * FROM POST a INNER JOIN POST_PHOTO_DETAIL b ON(a.POST_PHOTO = b.POST_PHOTO) WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} order by POST_DATE desc
mapper.update: UPDATE PROFILE SET PROFILE_INTRO = #{profile_intro}, PROFILE_URL = #{profile_url}, PROFILE_PHOTO = #{profile_photo}, PROFILE_HEADERPHOTO = #{profile_headerphoto} WHERE MEM_ID = #{mem_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FRIEND WHERE (FRIEND_FROMID = #{loginMemberId} AND FRIEND_TOID = #{profileOwnerId}) OR (FRIEND_FROMID = #{profileOwnerId} AND FRIEND_TOID = #{loginMemberId})
